strategies.name: Best Scalping Strategy
strategies.details:
Liquidity Grab + EMA Tap: Price sweeps a low, taps 20 EMA, prints bullish engulfing → Buy scalp.

Breakout Retest: 5m range breaks, price retests breakout level, volume spike → Enter continuation.

Reversal Scalps: Only if higher timeframe shows overextension; fade a sweep back into range.
